nodes.title: Richtofen · turn on the power
nodes.instruction: After the shared Tower of Babble setup, turn on the map power to start Richtofen's route. Keep power on while heating the pylon with the Jet Gun.
nodes.detection: Completes only when a TranZit snapshot reports the stock power_on flag. Route selection and sidequest start do not complete this step.

nodes.title: Start Tower of Babble
nodes.instruction: Build the shared Power Switch and Turbine setup, then activate Tower of Babble at the power station. Once the quest starts, choose A for Richtofen or B for Maxis; the tracker follows the game's route signal.

items.label: Large switch
items.location: Power Station lower switch room; randomized point in room.

items.label: Handle
items.location: Power Station lower switch room; randomized point in room.

items.label: Severed hand
items.location: Power Station lower switch room; randomized point in room.

items.label: Fan
items.location: Bus Depot start room; randomized room spawn.

items.label: Tail fin
items.location: Bus Depot start room; randomized room spawn.

items.label: Mannequin
items.location: Bus Depot start room; randomized room spawn.

nodes.detection: The stock sidequest initializes its quest-progress tracker after it starts.

nodes.title: Maxis · first step: power off and place two Turbines at the pylon
nodes.instruction: Turn map power off to start Maxis's route, then place two powered Turbines beneath the cornfield pylon and keep both running. The tracker stays on this first Maxis objective until the stock game confirms both Turbines.

items.label: Turbine 1
items.location: Build at Bus Depot bench from the three parts listed in shared setup.

items.label: Turbine 2
items.location: Build a second Turbine at Bus Depot bench; parts are another set in the same spawn area.

nodes.detection: Stock Maxis stage 2 is recorded after both Turbines reach the pylon area. Stage 1 only selects Maxis and does not complete this objective.

nodes.title: Maxis · stun the Avogadro beneath the pylon
nodes.instruction: Once both Turbines are powered, lure the Avogadro beneath the pylon and stun it with an EMP grenade. Do not EMP the Turbines.

items.label: EMP grenade
items.location: Mystery Box; avoid hitting Turbines.

nodes.detection: Stock Maxis stage 3 follows the Avogadro stun under the pylon with both Turbines powered.

nodes.title: Maxis · power two separate Screecher lights
nodes.instruction: With power off and the pylon and Avogadro objectives complete, use Turbines at two different Screecher-light zones. The game confirms this route only when the whole quest succeeds.

items.label: Two Turbines
items.location: Use the two Turbines assembled from the Bus Depot parts; place at separate Screecher-light zones.

nodes.detection: Stock Maxis completion stat is written after all three parallel Maxis objectives complete.

nodes.title: Richtofen · heat the pylon with the Jet Gun
nodes.instruction: Richtofen's route requires map power on. Fully charge the Jet Gun, aim it beneath the cornfield pylon, and fire until it breaks.

checklists.title: Jet Gun · build at Town workbench

items.label: Jet engine
items.location: Tunnel between Bus Depot/Diner; several spawn points by cars/windows.

items.label: Wires
items.location: Power Station lower lava level near Tombstone; check room.

items.label: Handbrake
items.location: Nacht der Untoten in cornfield; lamp, cabinets, stairs/desk.

items.label: Pressure gauge
items.location: Hunter's Cabin between Power Station and Town; fireplace or bed/back door.

nodes.detection: Stock Richtofen stage 2 is recorded when the Jet Gun overheats at the pylon.

nodes.title: Richtofen · get 25 explosive kills beneath the pylon
nodes.instruction: After heating the pylon, kill 25 zombies beneath it with explosives. The lobby's kills count together.

items.label: Explosives for 25 kills
items.location: Standard grenades or explosive weapons from Mystery Box; use beneath the pylon.

nodes.detection: Stock Richtofen stage 3 is recorded when the pylon explosive-kill counter reaches zero.

nodes.title: Richtofen · EMP the four green lamps
nodes.instruction: After the explosive-kill step, EMP four separate green Screecher lights. Coordinate the throws; the lights must remain disabled together.

items.label: EMP grenades
items.location: Mystery Box; obtain four for four separate lamps.

nodes.detection: Stock Richtofen completion stat is written after the four-light finale succeeds.

maxis: Maxis route: Get a Ballistic Knife

nodes.title: Start High Maintenance
nodes.instruction: Restore power and build the NAVcard table. The stock quest first records its shared opening when the opening sequence begins.

checklists.title: NAVcard table · four parts on the starting building roof

items.label: Build table
items.location: Roof wall below the catwalk ramp leading to the tower.

nodes.detection: The map stock sidequest stage begins.

nodes.title: Activate the four elevator symbols
nodes.instruction: Stand on the four gold symbols above the elevators. The game exposes each activation and confirms the full set.
nodes.detection: Stock elevator flags and sq_atd_elevator_activated flag.

nodes.title: Solve the floor-symbol sequence
nodes.instruction: Step on the four floor symbols in the order indicated by the game. The symbol puzzle resets on an incorrect sequence.

items.location: Workbench two elevator floors below the Quick Revive elevator. Four are needed for the pylon step.

nodes.detection: Stock sq_atd_drg_puzzle_complete flag.

nodes.title: Shoot the two dragon balls
nodes.instruction: Use a sniper rifle to shoot both balls in the dragon statues’ mouths. This is the stock shared step before the faction routes.

items.label: Sniper Rifle
items.location: Buy SVU-AS from wall-buy in Department Store, or obtain a sniper rifle from Mystery Box.

nodes.detection: Stock sniper-ball entities are removed when both targets are hit.

nodes.title: Richtofen · complete the Sliquifier objective
nodes.instruction: Follow Richtofen’s Sliquifier and trampling objectives.

items.label: Foot
items.location: Room above Power Room, rubble floor by couch/TV.

items.label: Bottle
items.location: Tables in Power Room.

items.label: Handle

items.label: Disc/chassis
items.location: Drum across from workbench at stair bottom, or table before Power Room.

nodes.detection: The selected stock tower-completion flag confirms this route branch has completed.

nodes.title: Richtofen · charge the tower
nodes.instruction: Continue the Richtofen tower sequence with the required Galvaknuckles.

items.label: Galvaknuckles
items.location: Wall buy in the elevator shaft/drop route down toward the Buddha Room.

nodes.detection: The selected stock tower-completion flag confirms this route branch has completed.

nodes.title: Maxis · complete the Buddha objective
nodes.instruction: Complete Maxis’s Buddha kill objective and prepare the ballistic knife sequence.

items.label: Ballistic Knife
items.location: Mystery Box; obtain after Maxis cue. Pack-a-Punch and fire in Buddha Room. The wielder must not have bought Bowie Knife/Galvaknuckles or bled out.

nodes.detection: The selected stock tower-completion flag confirms this route branch has completed.

nodes.instruction: Continue Maxis’s tower sequence with the required Galvaknuckles.

items.label: Galvaknuckles
items.location: Wall buy in the elevator shaft/drop route down toward the Buddha Room.

nodes.detection: The selected stock tower-completion flag confirms this route branch has completed.

nodes.title: Complete the final pylon sequence
nodes.instruction: Use the tile order to melee the pylon with Galvaknuckles and complete High Maintenance.

items.label: Galvaknuckles
items.location: Wall buy in the elevator shaft/drop route down toward the Buddha Room.

nodes.detection: The stock highrise_sidequest_achieved completion notification.

maxis: Maxis route: Build the Gallows tower
richtofen: Richtofen route: Build the Guillotine tower

nodes.title: Start Mined Games
nodes.instruction: The stock quest has started. Its first objective is the route choice: build the Gallows tower for Maxis or the Guillotine tower for Richtofen. The tracker will follow the tower your lobby builds.
nodes.detection: The observer sees the stock tower-build stage begin, before either tower is built.

nodes.title: Acquire the ghost lantern
nodes.instruction: Knock down the ghost lantern, pick it up, and follow the stock cues.
nodes.detection: The stock stage advances.

nodes.title: Charge the lantern
nodes.instruction: Charge the lantern with route-specific zombie kills, then continue when the stock stage advances.
nodes.detection: The stock stage advances.

nodes.title: Read the three sign ciphers
nodes.instruction: Use the cipher clue to identify the three tunnel signs for the wisp sequence.
nodes.detection: The stock stage advances.

nodes.title: Maxis · build the Gallows tower
nodes.instruction: Build the Gallows tower. The stock tower flag selects Maxis and is observed as soon as the build completes.

items.label: Battery
items.location: Behind the altar in the Church.

items.label: Spool of wire
items.location: Gunsmith Shop, downstairs room near the Bank tunnel.

items.label: Antenna
items.location: Barn lower level, stable by tunnel entrance.

items.label: Bulbs
items.location: Second floor of Jail building, on boxes near Mystery Box spawn.

nodes.detection: Stock Maxis tower-built flag.

nodes.title: Richtofen · build the Guillotine tower
nodes.instruction: Build the Guillotine tower. The stock tower flag selects Richtofen and is observed as soon as the build completes.

items.label: Satellite dish
items.location: Second floor of Saloon; reach via cave path from mine entrance.

items.label: Red crystal
items.location: Cave path up to Saloon second floor or Saloon balcony.

items.location: Gunsmith Shop near Bank entrance.

items.label: Antenna

nodes.detection: Stock Richtofen tower-built flag.

nodes.title: Complete the wisp and time-bomb sequence
nodes.instruction: Repeat the sign, wisp, and time-bomb objectives until the stock sq_wisp_success flag confirms success.

items.label: Paralyzer
items.location: Mystery Box; needed to heat/charge the route orbs.

nodes.detection: Stock sq_wisp_success flag, which is set only after the wisp sequence succeeds.

nodes.title: Complete the Time Bomb round-infinity objective
nodes.instruction: Place and detonate the Time Bomb at the selected tower, find the switch during Round Infinity, then return it.

items.label: Time Bomb
items.location: Mystery Box; place by the selected tower for Round Infinity.

nodes.detection: The stock stage advances.

nodes.title: Solve the route finale switchboard
nodes.instruction: Complete the stock lightboard sequence for the selected route.

items.label: Galvaknuckles
items.location: Maze wall buy; use on the route's cipher-selected signs.

nodes.detection: The stock stage advances.

nodes.title: Maxis · complete Mined Games
nodes.instruction: Finish the shared fountain sharpshooter challenge to complete Maxis’s Mined Games route.
nodes.detection: Stock sidequest completion state.

nodes.title: Richtofen · complete Mined Games
nodes.instruction: Finish the shared fountain sharpshooter challenge to complete Richtofen’s Mined Games route.
nodes.detection: Stock sidequest completion state.

nodes.title: Maxis · destroy the four amplifiers
nodes.instruction: Use the Subsurface Resonator to break all four amplifiers.
nodes.detection: Stock sq_amplifiers_broken flag.

nodes.title: Richtofen · charge the four amplifiers
nodes.instruction: Use the Wave Gun to charge all four amplifiers.
nodes.detection: Stock sq_amplifiers_on flag.

nodes.title: Complete the fountain sharpshooter challenge
nodes.instruction: Use the fountain to start the sharpshooter challenge and hit all four cowboy targets.
nodes.detection: Stock sq_ows_success flag.

shared: Play with at least two players
Break-cycle route: have the Weasel in the game
continue_cycle: Continue-cycle route: team must win the showdown
break_cycle: Break-cycle route: Weasel must win the showdown

nodes.title: Complete the generator challenge
nodes.instruction: Complete the generator challenge to open the relevant Warden doors and reach the plane parts.
nodes.detection: Stock generator_challenge_completed flag.

nodes.title: Collect the plane parts
nodes.instruction: Find the Warden’s Key and collect the five plane parts: uniforms, rigging, engine, fuel tanks, and control valve. The observer confirms after the Key and all five stock part flags are set.
nodes.detection: All five plane-part flags and the separate Warden Key flag are observed.

nodes.title: Assemble the plane
nodes.instruction: Build the plane on the roof after collecting its parts.

items.label: Assemble Icarus
items.location: Plane assembly ramp in middle of Roof; collect five parts first.

nodes.detection: Stock plane_built flag.

nodes.title: Complete three bridge round trips
nodes.instruction: Fly to the bridge and return to the prison three times, refueling between trips.
nodes.detection: Stock quest_completed_thrice flag.

nodes.title: Collect the five skulls
nodes.instruction: Use the Hell’s Retriever to collect the five hidden skulls and claim the Blundergat reward.

items.label: Hell's Retriever
items.location: Feed all three Hellhound heads; claim at afterlife portal at bottom of Citadel Tunnels.

nodes.detection: Stock warden_blundergat_obtained flag.

nodes.title: Collect both spoons
nodes.instruction: Use the Hell’s Retriever and Afterlife to collect the two spoons required for the final quest.

items.label: Hell's Retriever
items.location: Feed all three Hellhound heads; portal at bottom of Citadel Tunnels.

items.label: Afterlife
items.location: Enter using a down; needed for second spoon pickup.

nodes.detection: Stock spoon_obtained flag.

nodes.title: Solve the Nixie and audio steps; board the final flight
nodes.instruction: Complete the Nixie-tube codes and audio tour, then board the final plane when the game opens the showdown.
nodes.detection: Stock final_flight_activated state after the final quest setup.

nodes.title: Continue the cycle
nodes.instruction: Finish the final showdown with the team winning.
nodes.detection: Stock level.winner is team.

nodes.title: Break the cycle
nodes.instruction: Finish the final showdown with the Weasel winning.
nodes.detection: Stock level.winner is weasel.
